concept.hr: Fiksni kanali, zajednički skup ili put preko releja: tko dođe na red
concept.en: Fixed channels, a shared pool or a route through relays: who gets through

summary.hr: Isti pozivi u konvencionalnoj mreži s repetitorom i u trunkingu (TETRA): blokiranje, red čekanja i iskorištenost; mesh traži put preko releja.
summary.en: The same calls in a conventional repeater network and a trunked (TETRA) one: blocking, queueing and channel use; a mesh floods for a route via relays.
